## Things to know

::: {.callout-note}

In order to register you are required to download and sign a [Data Use Agreement](https://unsw.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/Datathon77/IQCqNEC6rp7qQa4WxKsBr-20AZ3lu0wamY7RLqU1OY9Xcas?e=QrTk9Z), so we recommend registering on a desktop/laptop. 

:::


* Registration is open to all enrolled UNSW students. December graduates can register provided their zID remains active. 
* You can register as a team of up to 5 people or as an individual (enter the team name **Individual**)
* **All** team members must register and sign the DUA. 
* Teams should decide on a team name in advance---this is required to register and will be used to link you to your team mates. If registering on your own use the team name **Individual** to be assigned to a team. 
* Teams with only 3-4 members may be paired with other participants to make a team of 5.

## Changes of registration

If one or more team members can no longer attend you can either:

(i) **Swap** out with a new member. The new team member **must** fill in the registration form. The departing team member should email the organisers at [m.hanly@unsw.edu.au](mailto:m.hanly@unsw.edu.au) to withdraw. 

(ii) **Withdraw** the entire team from the datathon. Email the organisers at [m.hanly@unsw.edu.au](mailto:m.hanly@unsw.edu.au) to withdraw all team members.
